TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Molucca Sea
DATE 5 November 2028 · 0710 local
SIDE People's Liberation Army Navy
WINDOW 40 min, closes at 60
Type 054A frigate. Photo: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Scott Ta... · Public domain · cropped
"It's not enough to talk about deterrence: I believe we must demonstrate that we can deliver air power to degrade, disrupt, destroy, and defeat."
- Air Marshal Stephen Chappell, Chief of Air Force, RAAF, 2026

MOLUCCA SEA, 0710. Two missile craft hired through a Meridian charter have attacked a coastal patrol outside the group's area and are now closing FUJIAN from the east and north-east. Their launchers are trained towards the group. Headquarters has declared those two craft hostile: engage them. Expect the first missile salvo at about minute eight if they are left alone, and another bearing shortly afterwards.

Your screen is already ahead of the carrier. Bring FUJIAN to the nearby morning station and destroy both missile craft. Use the preparation phase to ready her flight deck, set the screen's sensors and weapons, and decide whether to intercept the shooters or meet their missiles. You do not have to wait for them to fire.

DIPPER 21 also has a diesel-submarine report twelve miles astern of FUJIAN: ALPHA. A class on her earns intelligence credit but does not hold up completion. She has not attacked. The Australian Poseidon, Triton and Wedgetail are also observing. These non-belligerents use neutral tactical symbols and are protected; normal defensive settings can engage the hostile craft without authorising fire on them.
A ferry, two tuna boats, a coaster and the Manado-Ambon service cross the picture. Identify the two missile craft; the rest of the traffic is not a target.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Fleet headquarters
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Protect the carrier and clear the two declared hostile missile craft. The coalition's submarine and surveillance aircraft are not part of that attack. Protect them as non-belligerents; do not give the coalition an incident it did not start.
• Destroy both missile craft and bring Fujian to the morning station
• Stop both hostile missile craft
• Do not attack the trailing submarine or surveillance aircraft
• Keep Fujian afloat
• Classify ALPHA if the screen can spare the search
• Harm no protected observer or civil contact

Your purchased screen and ship's flight. Allocated: Fujian and Dipper 21, a Z-18F. Hostile: two missile craft on separate bearings. Protected observers: ALPHA and three Australian surveillance aircraft. Civil traffic remains protected.

The planned window is 40 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 20 minutes more; the operation is closed at 60 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
